Libraries:

```{r}
# Some tips from Sisk:
# https://github.com/msisk1/MtH_NLP/blob/main/MtH_2026.qmd

library(tidyverse)
library(tidytext)
library(textstem)
library(ggrepel)
library(hunspell)
library(text2vec)
library(word2vec)
library(reticulate)
library(udpipe)
library(data.table)
library(jsonlite)
library(tinytable)

seed <- 3256L
set.seed(seed)

source("functions.R")

```

Load the text from the internet or a saved version

```{r}
# Get text version of MTH from Internet Archive
# Different formats: https://archive.org/download/ManTheHunter

if (!file.exists("man-the-hunter.txt")) {
  mth0 <- read_lines(
    "https://archive.org/download/ManTheHunter/Man%20the%20Hunter_djvu.txt"
  )
  write_lines(mth0, file = "man-the-hunter.txt")
} else {
  mth0 <- read_lines("man-the-hunter.txt")
}
```

Stop words:

```{r}
# Prepare stop words
# Remove a few words from the stop word list that are actually informative
# and add a few new stop words. Removing the "onix" stop words automatically
# removes these.
retain <- c(
  "man",
  "men",
  "group",
  "groups",
  "grouping",
  "grouped",
  "work",
  "works",
  "working",
  "worked",
  "area",
  "areas"
)

stop_words2 <-
  stop_words |>
  dplyr::filter(lexicon != "onix") |>
  filter(!word %in% retain) |> # Just in case
  add_row(word = c("pp", "set", "call"), lexicon = "Added") # add new stop words
```

Cleanup:

```{r}
# Remove frontmatter, and references
# and perform some cleanup before tokenizing
preface <- 75
main_text_start <- 746
references <- 36991

mth <-
  mth0[main_text_start:references] |>
  str_replace_all("‘", "'") |>
  str_replace_all("’", "'") |>
  str_replace_all("“", '"') |>
  str_replace_all("”", '"') |>
  str_flatten(collapse = " ") |>
  str_squish() |>
  str_replace_all("- ", "-") |>

  # Remove the volume title, per discussion with Sisk
  str_replace_all(regex("Man the Hunter", ignore_case = T), "MTH") |>

  # Some manual fixes
  str_replace_all("ofarcheological", "of archeological") |>
  str_replace_all("archeo", "archaeo") |>
  str_replace_all("Archeo", "Archaeo") |>
  str_replace_all("per cent", "percent") |>
  str_replace_all("wor ld", "world") |>
  str_replace_all("IKung", "!Kung") |>
  str_replace_all("Turn-bull", "Turnbull") |>
  str_replace_all("Wood-burn", "Woodburn") |>

  str_split_1(" ")
```

De-hyphenate when needed, and re-join text

```{r}
# Try to un-hyphenate words hyphenated at the
# end of a line but keeping hyphens in hyphenated compound words

# If the de-hyphenated version is a word, then de-hyphenate
dehyphenatedisword <- hunspell_check(str_remove_all(mth, "[:punct:]"))
mth[dehyphenatedisword] <- str_remove_all(mth[dehyphenatedisword], "-")

# Otherwise, if the hyphenated word isn't a word then de-hyphenate and hope for the best
isaword <- hunspell_check(str_remove_all(mth, "[^[:alnum:]-]"))
ishyphenated <- str_detect(mth, "-")
mth[!isaword & ishyphenated] <- str_remove(mth[!isaword & ishyphenated], "-")

# Cleaned up text
mth_clean <- str_flatten(mth, collapse = " ")
# write(mth_clean, "mth_clean.txt")
mth_clean_length <- str_count(mth_clean) + 10
```

Check if any common stop words are important and should be removed from the stopword list

```{r}
mth_lower <- str_to_lower(mth)
mth_stopwords <- mth_lower[mth_lower %in% stop_words2$word]
sort(table(mth_stopwords), decreasing = T)[1:150]
```

```{python}
import spacy

spacy.util.fix_random_seed(r.seed)
nlp = spacy.load("en_core_web_sm")
nlp.max_length = r.mth_clean_length
doc = nlp(r.mth_clean)
```

Lemmas from spaCy

```{r}
doc2 <- iterate(py$doc)
lemmas_spacy <-
  tibble(
    word = map_chr(doc2, \(token) token$text),
    lemma = map_chr(doc2, \(token) token$lemma_),
    pos = map_chr(doc2, \(token) token$pos_)
  ) |>
  clean_lemmas()

# Reconstruct the full text as a single string
mth_spacy <- str_c(lemmas_spacy$lemma, collapse = " ")
```

udpipe lemmas

```{r}
# udpipe lemmatization that retains hyphenated compound words
# dl <- udpipe_download_model(language = "english")
# dl_gum <- udpipe_download_model(language = "english-gum")
ud_model <- udpipe_load_model(file = "english-gum-ud-2.5-191206.udpipe")
lemmas_udpipe <-
  udpipe_annotate(ud_model, x = mth_clean) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  rename(word = token, pos = upos) |>
  clean_lemmas() |> # See functions.R
  mutate(
    next_lemma = txt_next(lemma),
    bigram = paste(lemma, next_lemma)
  )

# Reconstruct the full text as a single string
mth_udpipe <- str_c(lemmas_udpipe$lemma, collapse = " ")
```

Count lemmas

```{r}
# Count lemmas
mth_words_spacy <-
  lemmas_spacy |>
  group_by(lemma) |>
  summarise(n = n()) |>
  arrange(desc(n))

mth_words_udpipe <-
  lemmas_udpipe |>
  group_by(lemma) |>
  summarise(n = n()) |>
  arrange(desc(n))

lemmas_sisk <-
  sisk_lemmas(mth0) |>
  rename(lemma = word, word = word_orig)

mth_words_sisk <-
  lemmas_sisk |>
  group_by(lemma) |>
  summarise(n = n()) |>
  arrange(desc(n))
```

Identifying major discrepancies. "cent" is mostly from "per cent" in the raw text; I unified the spelling of "archaeology", etc.; "brown" is mostly references to Radcliffe-Brown. "cross" mostly appears in the hyphentated "cross-cultural" or "cross-cousin". The Sisk lemmatizer often maps "number" to "numb", and many words to "good". Other discrepancies were addressed by iterating parts of the pipeline many times and making corrections in the `clean_lemmas` function.

```{r}
mth_words_combined <-
  full_join(mth_words_spacy, mth_words_udpipe, by = 'lemma') |>
  full_join(mth_words_sisk, by = 'lemma') |>
  rename(
    n_spacy = n.x,
    n_udpipe = n.y,
    n_sisk = n
  ) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    sd = sd(c(n_spacy, n_udpipe, n_sisk)),
    cv = sd / mean(c(n_spacy, n_udpipe, n_sisk))
  )

mth_words_discrepancies <-
  mth_words_combined |>
  dplyr::filter(
    cv > 0.25,
    n_spacy > 50 | n_udpipe > 50 | n_sisk > 50
  )

tt(arrange(mth_words_discrepancies, desc(cv)))
```

Compare frequencies of 200 most frequent words in spaCy and udpipe. Large discrepancies in hunter and gather are due, in part to the retention of the hyphenated "hunter-gatherer" in the udpipe version. Some of the biggest discrepancies were already addressed in the `clean_lemmas` function (see `functions.R`).

```{r}
d <-
  mth_words_combined |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(sd)) |>
  arrange(desc(n_udpipe))

ggplot(d[1:200, ], aes(n_spacy, n_udpipe, label = lemma)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text_repel(max.overlaps = 50) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0) +
  #   scale_x_log10() +
  #   scale_y_log10() +
  labs(x = "spaCy lemma count", y = "udpipe lemma count") +
  coord_fixed()
```

The Sisk lemmatizer maps "number" to "numb", and many more words to "good" than does the udpipe lemmatizer

```{r}
ggplot(d[1:200, ], aes(n_sisk, n_udpipe, label = lemma)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text_repel(max.overlaps = 50) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0) +
  labs(x = "Sisk lemma count", y = "udpipe lemma count") +
  coord_fixed()
```

Word vectors from Wiki Giga 2024. Find vectors of top 200 words from MTH relative to a large corpus of text from Wikipedia and newswire text such as the Associated Press (AP), Agence France-Presse (AFP), The New York Times, and the Xinhua News Agency.

```{r}
# Word embeddings: Wiki GIGA 2024
glove_raw <- fread(
  "wiki_giga_2024_100_MFT20_vectors_seed_2024_alpha_0.75_eta_0.05.050_combined.txt",
  header = FALSE,
  data.table = FALSE,
  encoding = "UTF-8"
)
glove_words <- glove_raw[, 1]
glove_matrix <- as.matrix(glove_raw[, -1])

# Assign the words as row names for fast lookup matrices
rownames(glove_matrix) <- glove_words
rm(glove_raw)

# Vectors for top 200
# Using spaCy because glove_words does not contain "hunter-gatherer"

wordvec200 <- glove_matrix[mth200spacy$lemma, ]
rm(glove_matrix)
```

Dimension reduction for plotting

```{python}
import pacmap

reducer = pacmap.PaCMAP(
    n_components=2,  # Coordinates for 2D plotting
    n_neighbors=15,  # Default is 10; raise slightly for small datasets
    MN_ratio=0.5,  # Mid-near neighbors ratio (default: 0.5)
    FP_ratio=2.0,  # Further-away pairs ratio (default: 2.0)
    lr=1.0,  # Learning rate
    num_iters=450,  # Default is 450 (100 mid, 200 far, 150 local)
    random_state=r.seed,
)
embedding = reducer.fit_transform(r.wordvec200)
```

Plot

```{r}
mth200 <- as_tibble(wordvec200, rownames = "lemma")
mth200$n <- mth200spacy$n
mth200$e1 <- py$embedding[, 1]
mth200$e2 <- py$embedding[, 2]
plot_vectors(mth200, "wordcloud.wiki.pdf")
```

word2vec embeddings, based only on the text of MTH

```{r}
# Chunk text for word2vec
mth_lemmatized <- map_chr(
  0:903,
  \(i) str_c(lemmas_udpipe$lemma[(i * 97 + 1):(i * 97 + 97)], collapse = " ")
)
# Train a MTH model with word2vec
mth_w2v <- word2vec(
  x = mth_lemmatized,
  type = "skip-gram",
  dim = 50, # Kept low to match 700k character text scale
  min_count = 1, # Keeps all compound words intact
  iter = 25,
  split = c(" ", ".\n?!")
)

mth_matrix <- as.matrix(mth_w2v)
wordvec200 <- mth_matrix[mth200udpipe$lemma, ]
```

Reduce dimensionality

```{python}
embedding = reducer.fit_transform(r.wordvec200)
```

Plot

```{r}
mth200 <- as_tibble(wordvec200, rownames = "lemma")
mth200$n <- mth200udpipe$n
mth200$e1 <- py$embedding[, 1]
mth200$e2 <- py$embedding[, 2]
plot_vectors(mth200, "wordcloud.w2v.pdf")
```

text2vec

```{r}
# text2vec word embeddings (GlobalVectors)
it <- itoken(mth_udpipe)
vocab <- create_vocabulary(lemmas_udpipe$lemma)
# vocab <- prune_vocabulary(vocab, term_count_min = 5L)
vectorizer <- vocab_vectorizer(vocab)
# use window of 5 for context words
tcm <- create_tcm(it, vectorizer, skip_grams_window = 5L)
glove <- GlobalVectors$new(rank = 50, x_max = 10)
wv_main <- glove$fit_transform(
  tcm,
  n_iter = 20,
  convergence_tol = 0.01,
  n_threads = 1
)
wv_context <- glove$components
word_vectors <- wv_main + t(wv_context)

wordvec200 <- word_vectors[mth200$lemma, ]
```

Reduce dimensionality

```{python}
embedding = reducer.fit_transform(r.wordvec200)
```

Plot

```{r}
mth200 <- as_tibble(wordvec200, rownames = "lemma")
mth200$n <- mth200udpipe$n
mth200$e1 <- py$embedding[, 1]
mth200$e2 <- py$embedding[, 2]
plot_vectors(mth200, "wordcloud.t2v.pdf")
```
